translations.web: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
translations.bsb: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
translations.kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
translations.asv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread and the prayers.
